# JSON Parser Java oracle fixtures

These fixtures contain 48 authored programs evaluated by the pinned Pkl 0.32.0 Java oracle with power assertions enabled and disabled (96 observations). The acquisition is `stage139-json-oracle-01`. They are Java results, never expected values generated by Rust.

`cases.txt` fixes the program order. Each case retains its exact source, URI, module name and expression. The `on` and `off` folders retain status and complete UTF-8 and original UTF-16 result fields. UTF-16 files contain big-endian code units; unpaired surrogates are preserved. UTF-8 fields retain Java's replacement behavior. Ordinary evaluation errors are expected outcomes for negative controls.

The Rust differential harness compares status and full expression/stdout/stderr bytes in both encodings without normalization. Java exception-class fields are retained as provenance; Rust has no corresponding Java class to compare. This authored expression corpus does not replace the five registered upstream JSON Parser CLI contracts or establish full language, API, platform or performance compatibility.

The captured corpus contains 1057 files; this README is project documentation added after acquisition and is not a captured oracle field. Source and runtime identities, raw acquisition outcomes and independent admission are retained in the Stage139 evidence.
